method: All six rendered pages read at 2×; p711 level line and p712 anatomical labels zoomed at 4×. Every printed instructional text block and named figure label/caption mapped in an explicitly documented traversal. Consecutive figure labels can share a matching question; this does not move later material before intervening source elements. Unlabelled radiographic details and unwritten grading definitions are not invented. Headers, footer, timestamps and blank Active space are excluded.
caveats: p711 fetal level is S1–S2 (4× confirmed), correcting old S1–S3 transcription. Arterial anastomosis preference, graft side and native-kidney retention are source descriptions, not universal surgical rules.
p712 ribs differ by side; the deeper right-side interlobular-artery label appears inconsistent with its position and is explicitly flagged. Surgical approaches are examples, not exhaustive rules.

p713 cotrimoxazole line literally has 200 mg mg BD × 3–5 days without component strengths: unsafe as a complete prescription, no corrected dose guessed. Other antibiotic doses are source-only recall with renal/formulation/local-guidance caveats. Normal ultrasound alone does not diagnose pyelonephritis.
p714–715 poor prognosis is not an invariant individual outcome. The childhood pathway is source-specific, not a rule to delay all urgent imaging.

p716 reflex is a typo for reflux in both papillary-type bullet lists. VUR figure labels and visible comparator/markers are covered; the page contains no written detailed grade criteria and no additional criteria are claimed.
